[heading=terms and definitions]
== Terms related to measurement and material flow

[[dpp-0123]]
=== mass balance model

chain of custody model in which materials or products with a set of specified characteristics are mixed according to defined criteria with materials or products without that set of characteristics

NOTE: The proportion of the input with specified characteristics can only match the initial proportions on average and will typically vary across different outputs.

[.source]
<<ISO22095,clause="3.3.4">>, <<CWA18291,clause="3.28">>
